Risk title: Segment orderbook dilutes utilization of the existing fleet
Cause: OUTCOME DRIVERS (market/context): industry deliveries temporarily exceed demand intensity in premium or adjacent segments. TRIDENT-SIDE FAILURE MODES (actionable): (1) orderbook and competitor delivery watch not tied to Trident utilization forecasts; (2) new awards pursued without testing dilution on the existing fleet; (3) no early trigger when segment utilization or rate softens versus plan; (4) segment mix bets not revisited when oversupply signals appear; (5) Commercial incentives favor volume over protecting existing utilization.
Risk event: Paid utilization and off-hire performance on existing vessels deteriorate below plan.
Consequences: Organic EBITDA, contract quality optics, and near-term cash conversion weaken.
Current mitigation: S&BD+Commercial: (1) maintain a segment orderbook/delivery watch linked to utilization forecast; (2) require an existing-fleet dilution test before pursuing material new awards; (3) set utilization/rate soft-landing triggers with escalation to SBD-P02/P05; (4) revisit segment mix bets when oversupply signals breach threshold; (5) weight Commercial scorecards to protect core fleet utilization, not only new volume.

Cause: OUTCOME DRIVERS (market/context): vessel reliability, maintenance quality, or operating discipline can fall below the organic performance agenda. TRIDENT-SIDE FAILURE MODES (actionable): (1) organic performance KPIs not linked to S&BD commercial and EBITDA plans; (2) maintenance and reliability shortfalls escalated late to Commercial/S&BD; (3) no joint Ops–Commercial recovery plan when vessels undershoot; (4) off-hire and reliability trends not in the renewal/portfolio forum; (5) performance agenda treated as Ops-only, so S&BD keeps selling capacity that under-delivers.
Risk event: Contribution margins and off-hire-adjusted operating results on the existing fleet miss plan.
Consequences: Organic EBITDA and cash conversion weaken even if rates hold.
Affected units: Vessel Operations; Technical & HSEQ; Strategy & BD
Current mitigation: S&BD+Ops: (1) link organic performance KPIs into SBD-P05/P06/P12 reviews; (2) escalate maintenance/reliability shortfalls early to Commercial and S&BD; (3) stand up a joint Ops–Commercial recovery plan when vessels undershoot; (4) put off-hire and reliability trends on the renewal/portfolio forum agenda; (5) withhold growth or rate push where open performance gaps remain.
